entries.content: Morning Star marks the first month. It brings bitter cold across Tamriel. Citizens celebrate the New Life Festival.
Sun's Dawn constitutes the second month. Winter storms persist heavily. People endure the biting frost.
First Seed heralds early spring. Farmers prepare their barren fields. A gentle warmth returns slowly.
Rain's Hand brings constant spring showers. The roads transform into muddy bogs. Flora blooms vividly across the provinces.
Second Seed marks late spring. The weather stabilizes beautifully. Travelers begin their long journeys.
Midyear introduces the summer heat. The days stretch long and bright. Merchants crowd the bustling marketplaces.
Sun's Height represents peak summer. Scorching temperatures dominate the landscape. Citizens seek cool shade constantly.
Last Seed concludes the summer season. Farmers harvest their abundant crops. A subtle chill touches the evening air.
Hearthfire initiates the autumn transition. Leaves turn brilliant orange and red. People prepare their winter stores.
Frostfall brings significant cold. Crisp winds sweep through the towns. The first snows begin falling.
Sun's Dusk darkens the skies early. The world prepares for winter slumber. Taverns overflow with travelers seeking warmth.
Evening Star concludes the year. Deep winter locks the land in ice. The Old Life Festival brings brief merriment.
The Tamrielic week spans seven days. The days are Morndas Tirdas Middas Turdas Fredas Loredas and Sundas. Citizens organize their labor around this cycle.
The current era is the Third Era. The year is 389. The Simulacrum defines this dark period.
Seasons drastically affect overland travel. Harsh winters block northern passes. Heavy rains flood southern roads.
